capabilities.evidence: MDM daily stock Parquet contains date, ticker, OHLCV, VWAP, transactions and ingestion fields, but has no immutable cross-dataset snapshot binding or row-level raw/adjusted declaration.
Available reference snapshots do not provide a complete adjudicated stable security/listing history, ticker-reuse history, or successor/predecessor chain.
Monthly reference exports are explicitly partial/review-required and locked pending approval.
No MDM-authoritative equity session spine with timezone, holidays, early closes and research cutoffs was found.
Split records exist, but a complete revision/cancellation and atomic snapshot contract is absent.
No complete authorised cash-distribution history was found.
No complete terminal-consideration and delisting-outcome history was found.
No MDM-wide immutable snapshot ID, common consistency token, source-file checksum manifest, or exact correction/replay contract was found.
The available proxy is tied to prior research and is prohibited for this independent project.

decision: No production Project EDGE feature-ready snapshot may be admitted from the audited MDM state. Synthetic safety evidence may exercise the implementation but may not enter research.
